summary: PulseGuard v0.6.16 restores the branded heartbeat, keeps Full Health Scan activity visible on Dashboard and Optimize, fixes CPU presentation, expands the Vendor Updates layout, and makes driver/update outcomes clearer without forcing Windows-ranked or BIOS updates.

sections.heading: Full Health Scan details stay on Dashboard
sections.detail: A persistent FULL HEALTH SCAN DETAILS panel now shows each background diagnostic stage while the scan runs and keeps the latest scan history visible after completion.

sections.heading: Post-fix rescan now writes into Optimize details
sections.detail: Every automatic post-fix Full Health Rescan stage is appended to LIVE OPTIMIZATION / CLEANUP DETAILS, including the final health score and background CPU result.

sections.heading: Background CPU keeps measured precision
sections.detail: Optimize displays the real settled total background CPU with one decimal place, while actionable/unresolved CPU remains the safety signal for regression warnings. During the automatic rescan the AFTER value shows Measuring... instead of a misleading temporary 0%.

sections.heading: Branded heartbeat restored and pinned
sections.detail: THANK YOU FOR TRUSTING PULSEGUARD PC and SYSTEM HEARTBEAT status text are restored. The heartbeat is slightly larger than v0.6.15 and pinned to the true bottom of the Dashboard.

sections.heading: Vendor Updates matches the approved layout
sections.detail: Vendor buttons and rows are larger, long explanations wrap inside the table, the final column consumes remaining width, and the table resizes to the visible Tools page instead of clipping text off-screen.

sections.heading: BIOS and driver actions are clearer
sections.detail: BIOS updates are explicitly labeled manual because PulseGuard never automatically flashes BIOS. Driver installation now explains when no actionable package exists or when Windows keeps its preferred current driver rather than implying a failed download.
